2026-11-05-tribal-knowledge.title: 42% of workplace knowledge lives in one person's head
2026-11-05-tribal-knowledge.text:
42% of workplace knowledge is unique to the individual. When that person retires, changes shifts or goes on vacation, nearly half of what they know walks out the door.

Four pillars keep it in the building:
1. Write the fix down at the machine, with photos
2. Pair people up and let the newer tech hold the meter
3. Teach the why, not just the steps
4. Check that it moved, with a sign-off

Start with your ten most frequent breakdowns.

Datumline keeps a time-stamped journal for every machine, with photos. TechProof gives technicians 48 plant-floor courses, with one license for the whole plant. Both from Syon Automation LLC: https://syonautomation.com

Source: Panopto with YouGov, Workplace Knowledge and Productivity Report (2018), 1,001 U.S. workers.

2026-11-05-why-4-20ma.title: Why does 4-20 mA start at 4?
2026-11-05-why-4-20ma.text:
Why does a 4-20 mA signal start at 4 and not 0? Because zero has to mean something is wrong.

- A live zero: a broken wire falls toward 0 mA, so the PLC knows it's a fault, not a reading
- 4 mA can power a 2-wire transmitter on the same pair as the signal
- Current is the same everywhere in a series loop, so long runs don't change the reading
- NAMUR NE 43: 3.8 to 20.5 mA is measurement; 3.6 mA or less, or 21 mA or more, signals a failure
- Scaling: % = (mA - 4) / 16 x 100, so 12 mA = 50%

TechProof course TP-202, 4-20 mA Loop Calibrator, walks technicians through it. https://syonautomation.com/techproof.html

Source: NAMUR NE 43 signal levels.

2026-11-05-idea-lube-route.title: A lube route in your pocket | App idea
2026-11-05-idea-lube-route.text:
SKF says poor lubrication accounts for over 36% of premature bearing failures.

An idea for our next app: a lube route in your pocket.
- Every grease point on a plant map: grease type, amount and interval
- A route in walking order
- Scan the QR tag at the point, log it, and the next due date sets itself
- Missed points turn red and the supervisor gets the list
- A photo at every point and a history for every bearing
- Audit report: what was greased, when, by whom, and how much
- Runs on your own network, no subscription

Would your plant use it? Tell us in the comments. The best ideas become the next Syon Automation LLC app.

Source: SKF, Lubricants technical data (2022).
